````javascript
    options: ['newton (N)', 'joule (J)', 'kilogram (kg)', 'watt (W)'],
    answer: 2,
    explain: 'The kilogram is one of the seven SI base units (with the metre, second, ampere, kelvin, mole and candela). The newton, joule and watt are all <b>derived</b> units: 1 N = 1 kg·m/s², 1 J = 1 N·m, 1 W = 1 J/s. ### `archive/js/sim-archimedes.js` (9.1 KiB)
````

````javascript
/* Sim — Archimedes bench. An object of adjustable density and volume settles in a tank: floats with submerged fraction rho_obj/rho_fluid, or sinks and receives a normal force from the floor. Every readout comes from F_B = rho_f * V_sub * g. Flat art only. */
(function () {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('sim-archimedes');
  if (!canvas) return;

  EMC.whenNear(canvas, init);
  function init() {

  const { CONST, clamp, fixed, eng, arrow, label, Stage, bindRange, bindSegment, setText, throttle } = EMC;
  const g = CONST.G;

  /* ---- state ------------------------------------------------------------- */
  const state = {
    rhoObj: 600,          // kg/m^3
    volL: 2,              // litres
    rhoF: 1000,           // kg/m^3 (fluid segment)
    shape: 'cube',
    y: 0,                 // centre depth below the waterline, metres (+ = down)
    dragging: false
  };
  const TANK_DEPTH = 1.1;                       // metres of water, surface to floor

  const phys = () => {
    const V = state.volL / 1000;                // m^3
    const s = Math.cbrt(V);                     // cube side, m (ball uses the same envelope)
    const W = state.rhoObj * V * g;
    const floats = state.rhoObj < state.rhoF - 0.5;
    const neutral = Math.abs(state.rhoObj - state.rhoF) <= 0.5;
    const f = clamp(state.rhoObj / state.rhoF, 0, 1);          // submerged fraction at rest
    const yEq = floats || neutral ? (f - 0.5) * s : TANK_DEPTH - s / 2;
    // instantaneous submerged fraction from the current position
    const depthSub = clamp(state.y + s / 2, 0, s);
    const fNow = neutral || !floats ? (state.y >= yEq - 1e-6 ? (floats ? f : 1) : depthSub / s) : depthSub / s;
    const FB = state.rhoF * V * clamp(fNow, 0, 1) * g;
    const atRest = Math.abs(state.y - yEq) < 1e-3;
    const onFloor = !floats && !neutral && atRest;
    const N = onFloor ? Math.max(0, W - FB) : 0;
    return { V, s, W, FB, N, floats, neutral, f, fNow: clamp(fNow, 0, 1), yEq, atRest, onFloor };
  };

  /* ---- geometry ------------------------------------------------------------ */
  function geom(w, h) {
    const l = w * 0.18, r = w * 0.82, t = h * 0.06, b = h * 0.94;
    const surface = t + (b - t) * 0.16;
    return { l, r, t, b, surface, pxPerM: (b - surface) / TANK_DEPTH, cx: (l + r) / 2 };
  }

  let vy = 0;
  const stage = new Stage(canvas, (ctx, w, h, st, dt) => {
    const p = phys();
    // settle towards equilibrium (spring-damper, only when not dragged)
    if (!state.dragging) {
      const k = 26, c = 9;
      const a = k * (p.yEq - state.y) - c * vy;
      vy += a * (dt || 0.016);
      state.y += vy * (dt || 0.016);
      if (Math.abs(p.yEq - state.y) < 1e-4 && Math.abs(vy) < 1e-3) { state.y = p.yEq; vy = 0; }
    }
    const settled = !state.dragging && Math.abs(p.yEq - state.y) < 1e-4 && Math.abs(vy) < 1e-3;
    stage.setIdle(settled);
    if (settled) updateReadouts();          // final synchronous write before sleeping
    render(ctx, w, h, st, p);
    readoutsLive();               // capped at 15 Hz; controls below call updateReadouts() directly
  }, { animate: true });

  function render(ctx, w, h, st, p) {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    const G = geom(w, h);
    const sPx = p.s * G.pxPerM;
    const cy = G.surface + state.y * G.pxPerM;

    // tank + water (flat translucent fill)
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(168,211,224,.14)';
    ctx.fillRect(G.l, G.surface, G.r - G.l, G.b - G.surface);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#5b7299'; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(G.l, G.t); ctx.lineTo(G.l, G.b); ctx.lineTo(G.r, G.b); ctx.lineTo(G.r, G.t);
    ctx.stroke();
    // waterline
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#a8d3e0'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(G.l, G.surface); ctx.lineTo(G.r, G.surface); ctx.stroke();
    // depth ruler
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(148,163,184,.4)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let d = 0.2; d < TANK_DEPTH; d += 0.2) {
      const yy = G.surface + d * G.pxPerM;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(G.l + 4, yy); ctx.lineTo(G.l + 16, yy); ctx.stroke();
      label(ctx, `${fixed(d, 1)} m`, G.l + 22, yy, { color: '#7b8db0', size: 9.5, align: 'left' });
    }
    ctx.restore();
    label(ctx, `${state.rhoF} kg/m³ fluid`, G.r - 8, G.surface - 10, { color: '#a8d3e0', size: 11, align: 'right' });

    // the object
    const submergedTop = Math.max(cy - sPx / 2, G.surface);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f6f1e5'; ctx.strokeStyle = '#3a3d45'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    if (state.shape === 'cube') {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(G.cx - sPx / 2, cy - sPx / 2, sPx, sPx); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
      if (submergedTop < cy + sPx / 2) {                 // submerged part tinted
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(168,211,224,.45)';
        ctx.fillRect(G.cx - sPx / 2, submergedTop, sPx, cy + sPx / 2 - submergedTop);
      }
    } else {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(G.cx, cy, sPx / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.save();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(G.cx, cy, sPx / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.clip();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(168,211,224,.45)';
      ctx.fillRect(G.cx - sPx, submergedTop, sPx * 2, cy + sPx);
      ctx.restore();
    }
    ctx.restore();
    label(ctx, `${state.rhoObj} kg/m³`, G.cx, cy, { color: '#2b2d33', size: 11.5, weight: '800' });

    // force arrows: weight down, buoyancy up, normal up (at the floor)
    const fScale = 26 / Math.max(p.W, 1);                 // px per newton, relative to W
    arrow(ctx, G.cx, cy, G.cx, cy + p.W * fScale + 14, { color: '#f8aebe', width: 3 });
    label(ctx, `W ${eng(p.W, 3)} N`, G.cx + 14, cy + p.W * fScale + 22, { color: '#f8aebe', size: 11, align: 'left' });
    if (p.FB > 0.01) {
      arrow(ctx, G.cx, cy, G.cx, cy - p.FB * fScale - 14, { color: '#a8d3e0', width: 3 });
      label(ctx, `F_B ${eng(p.FB, 3)} N`, G.cx - 14, cy - p.FB * fScale - 22, { color: '#a8d3e0', size: 11, align: 'right' });
    }
    if (p.N > 0.01) {
      arrow(ctx, G.cx + sPx * 0.7, G.b - 4, G.cx + sPx * 0.7, G.b - 4 - p.N * fScale - 10, { color: '#f6d36b', width: 2.6 });
      label(ctx, `N ${eng(p.N, 3)} N`, G.cx + sPx * 0.7 + 12, G.b - 16, { color: '#f6d36b', size: 11, align: 'left' });
    }

    label(ctx, state.dragging ? 'release to let it settle' : 'drag the block up or down',
      w / 2, h - 10, { color: 'rgba(148,163,184,.8)', size: 10.5, weight: '600' });
  }

  /* ---- pointer: drag the object -------------------------------------------- */
  stage.onPointer(p => {
    const G = geom(stage.w, stage.h);
    const ph = phys();
    const sPx = ph.s * G.pxPerM;
    const cy = G.surface + state.y * G.pxPerM;
    if (p.type === 'down') {
      const hit = Math.abs(p.x - G.cx) < sPx && Math.abs(p.y - cy) < sPx;
      state.dragging = hit; vy = 0;
      if (hit) stage.setIdle(false);
      canvas.style.cursor = hit ? 'grabbing' : 'default';
    } else if (p.type === 'move' && state.dragging) {
      state.y = clamp((p.y - G.surface) / G.pxPerM, -ph.s * 0.9, TANK_DEPTH - ph.s / 2);
    } else if (p.type === 'up' || p.type === 'leave') {
      state.dragging = false; canvas.style.cursor = 'default';
    }
  });

  /* ---- readouts --------------------------------------------------------------- */
  const el = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const readoutsLive = throttle(() => updateReadouts(), 15);
  function updateReadouts() {
    const p = phys();
    const set = (id, s) => setText(el(id), s);
    set('arch-weight', `${eng(p.W, 3)} N`);
    set('arch-buoy', `${eng(p.FB, 3)} N`);
    const net = p.W - p.FB - p.N;
    set('arch-net', p.atRest
      ? (p.floats || p.neutral ? '0 N \u2014 balanced' : `0 N \u2014 floor holds ${eng(p.N, 3)} N`)
      : `${eng(Math.abs(net), 3)} N ${net > 0 ? '\u2193' : '\u2191'}`);
    set('arch-subfr', `${fixed(p.fNow * 100, 1)} %`);
    set('arch-vsub', `${fixed(p.fNow * state.volL, 2)} L`);
    set('arch-state', p.neutral ? 'neutrally buoyant' : (p.floats ? 'floats' : 'sinks'));
    set('arch-explain', p.floats || p.neutral
      ? `Floating: the block settles until it displaces its own weight \u2014 submerged fraction = \u03C1obj/\u03C1fluid = ${state.rhoObj}/${state.rhoF} = ${fixed(p.f * 100, 1)}%, so F_B = W = ${eng(p.W, 3)} N.`
      : `Sinking: fully submerged it displaces ${fixed(state.volL, 2)} L, so F_B = \u03C1fluid\u00B7V\u00B7g = ${state.rhoF} \u00D7 ${fixed(p.V, 4)} \u00D7 ${fixed(g, 2)} = ${eng(state.rhoF * p.V * g, 3)} N < W = ${eng(p.W, 3)} N. On the floor the missing ${eng(p.N, 3)} N comes from the normal force.`);
  }

  function refresh() { updateReadouts(); }

  /* ---- controls ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  bindRange('arch-rho', 'arch-rhov', v => { state.rhoObj = v; stage.setIdle(false); stage.invalidate(); refresh(); }, v => `${v} kg/m³`);
  bindRange('arch-vol', 'arch-volv', v => { state.volL = v; stage.setIdle(false); stage.invalidate(); refresh(); }, v => `${fixed(v, 1)} L`);
  bindSegment('arch-fluid', v => { state.rhoF = Number(v); state.y = phys().yEq; vy = 0; stage.setIdle(false); stage.invalidate(); refresh(); });
  bindSegment('arch-shape', v => { state.shape = v; stage.setIdle(false); stage.invalidate(); refresh(); });

  // start at equilibrium
  state.y = phys().yEq;
  refresh();
  }
})();
````

### `archive/js/sim-bernoulli.js` (11.9 KiB)

````javascript
/* Sim — Bernoulli visualiser. Two scenes in one canvas: an aerofoil in a wind stream (lift from the top/bottom speed difference) and a venturi pipe (continuity + the pressure drop in the throat). All numbers come from P + 1/2 rho v^2 = const and A1 v1 = A2 v2. Flat art only. */
(function () {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('sim-bernoulli');
  if (!canvas) return;

  EMC.whenNear(canvas, init);
  function init() {

  const { CONST, clamp, fixed, eng, unit, arrow, label, Stage, bindRange, bindSegment, setText, throttle } = EMC;

  const state = {
    mode: 'wing',
    v: 15,            // m/s free-stream wind (wing mode)
    aoa: 6,           // deg angle of attack (wing mode)
    flow: 0.5,        // m/s in the wide section (pipe mode)
    ratio: 0.5,       // d2/d1 throat ratio (pipe mode)
    particles: []
  };
  const WING_AREA = 12;          // m^2, a light aircraft wing
  const D1 = 0.10;               // m, wide-section diameter

  /* ---- physics ----------------------------------------------------------- */
  function wingPhys() {
    const rho = CONST.RHO_AIR;
    const a = state.aoa * Math.PI / 180;
    const sTop = 1 + 0.20 + 1.5 * Math.sin(a);       // camber + angle speed-up
    const sBot = 1 - 0.6 * Math.sin(a);
    let vTop = state.v * sTop, vBot = state.v * sBot;
    const stalled = state.aoa > 15;
    const near = state.aoa > 10 && !stalled;
    const sep = stalled ? Math.max(0.15, 1 - (state.aoa - 15) / 5) : 1;  // separated flow kills lift
    const dP = 0.5 * rho * (vTop * vTop - vBot * vBot) * sep;
    return { vTop: vTop * (stalled ? 0.8 : 1), vBot, dP, lift: dP * WING_AREA, stalled, near, sep };
  }
  function pipePhys() {
    const rho = CONST.RHO_WATER;
    const v1 = state.flow;
    const v2 = v1 / (state.ratio * state.ratio);      // continuity: A2/A1 = ratio^2
    const dP = 0.5 * rho * (v2 * v2 - v1 * v1);
    const dh = dP / (rho * CONST.G);                  // metres of water column
    return { v1, v2, dP, dh, A1: Math.PI * D1 * D1 / 4, Q: Math.PI * D1 * D1 / 4 * v1 };
  }

  /* ---- particles ----------------------------------------------------------- */
  /* seeded=true fills the whole canvas on first paint so the scene is never
     empty; respawns enter from just off the left edge. */
  function spawnParticle(w, h, pipe, seeded) {
    return pipe
      ? { x: seeded ? Math.random() * w : -10, y: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.4 }
      : { x: seeded ? Math.random() * w : -10 - Math.random() * 30, y: 0.12 + Math.random() * 0.76 };
  }
  function ensureParticles(w, h) {
    const n = EMC.lowTier ? 30 : 46;
    while (state.particles.length < n) state.particles.push(spawnParticle(w, h, state.mode === 'pipe', true));
  }

  /* ---- wing scene ------------------------------------------------------------ */
  function wingScene(ctx, w, h, st, dt, p) {
    const cx = w * 0.5, cy = h * 0.52, chord = Math.min(w * 0.42, 300);
    const a = state.aoa * Math.PI / 180;

    // aerofoil polygon (cambered ellipse nose, flat-ish tail), rotated by aoa
    const prof = t => {                                 // t 0..1 along the chord
      const thick = 0.16 * Math.sin(Math.PI * Math.pow(t, 0.7));
      const camber = 0.07 * Math.sin(Math.PI * t);
      return { top: -(thick + camber), bot: thick * 0.7 - camber };
    };
    const rot = (tx, ty) => ({                          // chord coords -> canvas
      x: cx + (tx - 0.5) * chord * Math.cos(a) - ty * chord * Math.sin(a),
      y: cy + (tx - 0.5) * chord * Math.sin(a) + ty * chord * Math.cos(a)
    });
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e2e8f0'; ctx.strokeStyle = '#5b7299'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    const N = 26;
    let first = rot(0, prof(0).top);
    ctx.moveTo(first.x, first.y);
    for (let i = 1; i <= N; i++) { const q = rot(i / N, prof(i / N).top); ctx.lineTo(q.x, q.y); }
    for (let i = N; i >= 0; i--) { const q = rot(i / N, prof(i / N).bot); ctx.lineTo(q.x, q.y); }
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
    label(ctx, `AoA ${fixed(state.aoa, 0)}°`, rot(0.12, 0.24).x, rot(0.12, 0.24).y, { color: '#f6d36b', size: 11 });

    // stream particles: faster over the top, slower underneath; jitter when stalled
    ensureParticles(w, h);
    const pxScale = chord / 260;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#a8d3e0';
    for (const q of state.particles) {
      const above = q.y < 0.5;
      const span = clamp((q.x - (cx - chord * 0.6)) / (chord * 1.2), 0, 1);
      const bump = Math.sin(Math.PI * span);            // influence envelope over the wing
      const speedUp = above ? (1 + (p.sep < 1 ? 0.1 : 0.45) * bump) : (1 - 0.12 * bump);
      q.x += state.v * pxScale * 3.4 * speedUp * dt;
      const dy = above ? -0.10 * bump : 0.045 * bump;
      const jitter = p.stalled && above && span > 0.45 ? (Math.sin(st.t * 30 + q.y * 90) * 0.02) : 0;
      const yy = (q.y + dy + jitter) * h;
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.55 + 0.35 * bump;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(q.x, yy, 2.1, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      if (q.x > w + 12) Object.assign(q, spawnParticle(w, h, false, false));
    }
    ctx.restore();

    // speed / pressure captions + lift arrow
    label(ctx, 'fast flow · LOW pressure', cx + chord * 0.1, cy - chord * 0.34, { color: '#b5d777', size: 11.5, weight: '700' });
    label(ctx, 'slower flow · HIGHER pressure', cx + chord * 0.1, cy + chord * 0.36, { color: '#a8d3e0', size: 11.5, weight: '700' });
    const liftPx = clamp(p.lift / 40, 0, h * 0.3);
    if (liftPx > 6) {
      arrow(ctx, cx, cy - 10, cx, cy - 10 - liftPx, { color: '#b5d777', width: 4, head: 12 });
      label(ctx, `LIFT ${eng(p.lift, 3)} N`, cx + 14, cy - 16 - liftPx, { color: '#b5d777', size: 12, weight: '800', align: 'left' });
    }
    if (p.stalled) label(ctx, '⚠ STALL — the flow has separated', w / 2, h - 26, { color: '#fca5a5', size: 12.5, weight: '800' });
  }

  /* ---- pipe scene --------------------------------------------------------------- */
  function pipeScene(ctx, w, h, st, dt, p) {
    const y0 = h * 0.56, R = h * 0.16;                  // wide-section half-height
    const x0 = w * 0.08, x1 = w * 0.92;
    const t0 = w * 0.38, t1 = w * 0.62;                 // throat span
    const radiusAt = x => {
      if (x < t0) return R;
      if (x > t1) return R;
      if (x < (t0 + t1) / 2) {
        const s = (x - t0) / ((t1 - t0) / 2);
        return R + (R * state.ratio - R) * Math.sin(s * Math.PI / 2);
      }
      const s = (x - (t0 + t1) / 2) / ((t1 - t0) / 2);
      return R * state.ratio + (R - R * state.ratio) * Math.sin(s * Math.PI / 2);
    };
    // walls
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#5b7299'; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x += 4) { const y = y0 - radiusAt(x); x === x0 ? ctx.moveTo(x, y) : ctx.lineTo(x, y); }
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x += 4) { const y = y0 + radiusAt(x); x === x0 ? ctx.moveTo(x, y) : ctx.lineTo(x, y); }
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(168,211,224,.10)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x += 4) { const y = y0 - radiusAt(x); x === x0 ? ctx.moveTo(x, y) : ctx.lineTo(x, y); }
    for (let x = x1; x >= x0; x -= 4) ctx.lineTo(x, y0 + radiusAt(x));
    ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    // particles: x-speed follows continuity v(x) = Q/A(x)
    ensureParticles(w, h);
    const vOf = x => { const r = radiusAt(x) / R; return p.v1 / (r * r); };
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f6d36b';
    const pxPerM = 60;
    for (const q of state.particles) {
      q.x += vOf(q.x) * pxPerM * 2.2 * dt;
      if (q.x > x1 + 8) Object.assign(q, spawnParticle(w, h, true, false));
      const r = radiusAt(clamp(q.x, x0, x1)) * 0.82;
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.75;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(q.x, y0 + (q.y * 2 - 1) * r, 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();

    // manometer tubes over the wide section and the throat
    const tube = (x, heightFrac, txtP, txtV) => {
      const top = y0 - radiusAt(x) - 8;
      const th = h * 0.30 * heightFrac;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#5b7299'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.strokeRect(x - 7, top - th, 14, th);
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(168,211,224,.5)';
      ctx.fillRect(x - 5, top - th + 2, 10, th - 4);
      ctx.restore();
      label(ctx, txtV, x, top - th - 26, { color: '#f6d36b', size: 11, weight: '700' });
      label(ctx, txtP, x, top - th - 12, { color: '#a8d3e0', size: 10.5, weight: '700' });
    };
    const hFrac = clamp(p.dh / 0.6, 0.05, 1);            // scale: 0.6 m of water = full tube
    tube(w * 0.22, 0.95, `v₁ = ${fixed(p.v1, 2)} m/s`, 'P₁ (higher)');
    tube(w * 0.5, 0.95 - hFrac * 0.75, `v₂ = ${fixed(p.v2, 2)} m/s`, 'P₂ (lower)');
    label(ctx, `Δh = ${fixed(p.dh * 100, 1)} cm of water`, w * 0.5, y0 + R + 22, { color: '#b5d777', size: 11.5, weight: '700' });
    label(ctx, 'the throat column stands lower — faster flow, lower pressure', w / 2, h - 10,
      { color: 'rgba(148,163,184,.85)', size: 10.5, weight: '600' });
  }

  /* ---- main render ------------------------------------------------------------- */
  const stage = new Stage(canvas, (ctx, w, h, st, dt) => {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    const p = state.mode === 'wing' ? wingPhys() : pipePhys();
    if (state.mode === 'wing') wingScene(ctx, w, h, st, dt || 0.016, p);
    else pipeScene(ctx, w, h, st, dt || 0.016, p);
    updateReadouts(p);
  }, { animate: true });

  /* ---- readouts ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
  const el = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const readoutsLive = throttle(() => updateReadouts(), 15);
  function updateReadouts(p) {
    const wing = state.mode === 'wing';
    const q = p || (wing ? wingPhys() : pipePhys());
    setText(el('bern-l1'), wing ? 'free-stream v' : 'v in wide section');
    setText(el('bern-l2'), wing ? 'v over the top' : 'v in the throat');
    setText(el('bern-l3'), wing ? 'ΔP (top vs bottom)' : 'ΔP (wide vs throat)');
    setText(el('bern-l4'), wing ? `lift · ${WING_AREA} m² wing` : 'manometer Δh');
    setText(el('bern-v1'), `${fixed(q.v1 ?? state.v, 2)} m/s`);
    setText(el('bern-v2'), `${fixed(q.v2 ?? q.vTop, 2)} m/s`);
    const dP = wing ? q.dP : q.dP;
    setText(el('bern-dp'), unit(dP, 'Pa', 3));
    setText(el('bern-extra'), wing ? unit(q.lift, 'N', 3) : `${fixed(q.dh * 100, 1)} cm`);
    if (el('bern-state')) {
      el('bern-state').textContent = wing
        ? (q.stalled ? 'STALLED — flow separated' : q.near ? 'near stall — smooth flow ending' : 'attached flow')
        : 'continuity: A₁v₁ = A₂v₂';
    }
    if (el('bern-sub')) {
      el('bern-sub').textContent = wing
        ? `v_top = ${fixed(q.vTop, 1)} m/s > v_bot = ${fixed(q.vBot, 1)} m/s · ΔP = ½ρ(v_top² − v_bot²) = ${eng(q.dP, 3)} Pa · lift = ΔP × ${WING_AREA} m² = ${eng(q.lift, 3)} N`
        : `v₂ = v₁·(d₁/d₂)² = ${fixed(q.v1, 2)} × ${fixed(1 / (state.ratio * state.ratio), 2)} = ${fixed(q.v2, 2)} m/s · ΔP = ½ρ(v₂² − v₁²) = ${eng(q.dP, 3)} Pa`;
    }
  }

  /* ---- controls ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  bindRange('bern-v', 'bern-vv', v => { state.v = v; stage.invalidate(); updateReadouts(); }, v => `${fixed(v, 0)} m/s`);
  bindRange('bern-aoa', 'bern-aoav', v => { state.aoa = v; stage.invalidate(); updateReadouts(); }, v => `${fixed(v, 0)}°`);
  bindRange('bern-flow', 'bern-flowv', v => { state.flow = v; stage.invalidate(); updateReadouts(); }, v => `${fixed(v, 2)} m/s`);
  bindRange('bern-ratio', 'bern-ratiov', v => { state.ratio = v; stage.invalidate(); updateReadouts(); }, v => `d₂ = ${fixed(v * D1 * 100, 1)} cm`);

  function syncVisibility() {
    const wing = state.mode === 'wing';
    ['bern-ctl-v', 'bern-ctl-aoa'].forEach(id => { const n = el(id); if (n) n.style.display = wing ? '' : 'none'; });
    ['bern-ctl-flow', 'bern-ctl-ratio'].forEach(id => { const n = el(id); if (n) n.style.display = wing ? 'none' : ''; });
  }
  bindSegment('bern-mode', v => { state.mode = v; state.particles.length = 0; syncVisibility(); stage.invalidate(); updateReadouts(); });
  syncVisibility();
  updateReadouts();
  }
})();
````

### `archive/js/sim-heat-transfer.js` (14.7 KiB)

````javascript
/* Sim — heat transfer lab. Three scenes in one canvas: CONDUCTION (diffusion along a rod, flux q = kA*DeltaT/L), CONVECTION (circulating particles driven by a bottom heater) and RADIATION (inverse-square intensity absorbed by matt-black vs shiny plates). Flat art only: solid buckets of colour, no smooth blends. */
(function () {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('sim-heat-transfer');
  if (!canvas) return;

  EMC.whenNear(canvas, init);
  function init() {

  const { CONST, clamp, fixed, eng, unit, arrow, label, Stage, bindRange, bindSegment, setText, throttle } = EMC;

  const MATERIALS = {
    copper: { k: 401, name: 'copper', rate: 0.45 },
    iron:   { k: 80,  name: 'iron',   rate: 0.26 },
    glass:  { k: 1.0, name: 'glass',  rate: 0.08 },
    wood:   { k: 0.15, name: 'wood',   rate: 0.04 }
  };
  const ROD = { A: 1e-4, L: 0.4, N: 20, ambient: 20 };

  const state = {
    mode: 'conduction',
    material: 'copper',
    Thot: 300,            // degC, held hot end
    power: 800,           // W, heater / radiator output
    dist: 1,              // m, radiation distance
    T: new Array(ROD.N).fill(ROD.ambient),
    parts: []
  };
  state.T[0] = state.Thot;

  /* ---- colour buckets for temperature (flat steps, never a blend) --------- */
  const BUCKETS = [
    [40, '#6f9db3'], [100, '#b5d777'], [200, '#f6d36b'], [400, '#ef9f68'], [Infinity, '#ef6f8e']
  ];
  const heatColor = T => (BUCKETS.find(b => T <= b[0]) || BUCKETS[4])[1];

  /* ---- physics ------------------------------------------------------------- */
  function stepConduction(dt) {
    const a = MATERIALS[state.material].rate * clamp(dt * 60, 0, 2);
    const T = state.T;
    T[0] = state.Thot;
    T[ROD.N - 1] = ROD.ambient;                     // both ends are reservoirs
    for (let i = ROD.N - 2; i >= 1; i--) {
      T[i] += a * (T[i - 1] + T[i + 1] - 2 * T[i]);
    }
  }
  const flux = () => {
    const k = MATERIALS[state.material].k;
    return k * ROD.A * (state.T[0] - state.T[ROD.N - 1]) / ROD.L;
  };
  const intensity = () => state.power / (4 * Math.PI * state.dist * state.dist);

  /* ---- particles (convection) ----------------------------------------------- */
  const PARTS = EMC.lowTier ? 42 : 70;
  function ensureParts() {
    while (state.parts.length < PARTS) {
      state.parts.push({ x: Math.random() * 2 - 1, y: Math.random() });   // x in [-1,1], y 0 top .. 1 bottom
    }
  }

  /* ---- scenes ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  function conductionScene(ctx, w, h, st, dt) {
    stepConduction(dt);
    const rodL = w * 0.62, rodH = Math.min(h * 0.15, 54);
    const x0 = (w - rodL) / 2, y0 = h * 0.30;
    const cw = rodL / ROD.N;

    // flame (flat triangles) at the hot end, heatsink at the cold end
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f6d36b';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x0 - 26, y0 + rodH); ctx.lineTo(x0 - 8, y0 - 12); ctx.lineTo(x0 - 2, y0 + rodH); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ef6f8e';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x0 - 20, y0 + rodH); ctx.lineTo(x0 - 11, y0 + 4); ctx.lineTo(x0 - 5, y0 + rodH); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#6f9db3';
    ctx.fillRect(x0 + rodL + 6, y0 - 6, 20, rodH + 12);
    ctx.restore();
    label(ctx, `${fixed(state.Thot, 0)} °C`, x0 - 14, y0 + rodH + 18, { color: '#f6d36b', size: 11.5, weight: '700' });
    label(ctx, `${ROD.ambient} °C`, x0 + rodL + 16, y0 + rodH + 18, { color: '#a8d3e0', size: 11.5, weight: '700' });

    // rod cells + vibrating atoms (amplitude grows with temperature)
    for (let i = 0; i < ROD.N; i++) {
      const T = state.T[i];
      ctx.save();
      ctx.fillStyle = heatColor(T);
      ctx.fillRect(x0 + i * cw + 1, y0, cw - 2, rodH);
      ctx.restore();
      const amp = clamp(T / 500, 0, 1) * rodH * 0.28;
      const jy = y0 + rodH / 2 + Math.sin(st.t * (6 + T / 40) + i * 2.4) * amp;
      const jx = x0 + i * cw + cw / 2 + Math.cos(st.t * (5 + T / 50) + i) * amp * 0.5;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(20,22,28,.85)';
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(jx, jy, 2.6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    }

    // temperature profile under the rod
    const gy = h * 0.60, gh = h * 0.26, gx0 = x0, gw = rodL;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(148,163,184,.3)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeRect(gx0, gy, gw, gh);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#e8eefb'; ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    const Tmax = Math.max(state.Thot, 100);
    for (let i = 0; i < ROD.N; i++) {
      const px = gx0 + (i / (ROD.N - 1)) * gw;
      const py = gy + gh - (state.T[i] / Tmax) * gh;
      i === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(px, py) : ctx.lineTo(px, py);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
    label(ctx, 'temperature profile along the rod', gx0 + gw / 2, gy + gh + 14, { color: '#7b8db0', size: 10.5 });
    label(ctx, `${MATERIALS[state.material].name} · k = ${MATERIALS[state.material].k} W/(m·K)`, w / 2, 16,
      { color: '#f6d36b', size: 12, weight: '700' });
  }

  function convectionScene(ctx, w, h, st, dt) {
    ensureParts();
    const px = w * 0.14, py = h * 0.12, pw = w * 0.72, ph = h * 0.70;

    // pot
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(168,211,224,.10)';
    ctx.fillRect(px, py, pw, ph);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#5b7299'; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.strokeRect(px, py, pw, ph);
    // heater bar, brightness buckets with power
    const hb = clamp((state.power - 200) / 1800, 0, 1);
    ctx.fillStyle = hb > 0.66 ? '#ef6f8e' : hb > 0.33 ? '#ef9f68' : '#f6d36b';
    ctx.fillRect(px + pw * 0.32, py + ph - 10, pw * 0.36, 10);
    ctx.restore();
    label(ctx, `heater ${state.power} W`, px + pw / 2, py + ph + 16, { color: '#f6d36b', size: 11.5, weight: '700' });

    // circulation field: rise in the middle, sink at the walls, loop along top/bottom
    const S = 0.28 * (0.5 + state.power / 2000);
    const field = (x, y) => {                        // x in [-1,1], y 0 top .. 1 bottom
      const rise = Math.cos(Math.PI * x / 2) ** 2;   // 1 centre -> 0 walls
      const vy = S * (0.4 - rise);                   // negative = up near centre
      const out = Math.sign(x || 1) * (0.55 * (1 - y) - 0.45 * y);
      return { vx: S * out * 0.8, vy };
    };
    // local temperature: hot near the heater, cool at the top corners
    const tempAt = (x, y) => 20 + (35 + 45 * state.power / 2000) *
      Math.exp(-((x * 1.5) ** 2 + ((1 - y) * 1.6) ** 2)) + 10 * (1 - y) * 0;

    ctx.save();
    for (const q of state.parts) {
      const f = field(q.x, q.y);
      q.x += f.vx * dt * 3.4; q.y += f.vy * dt * 3.4;
      if (q.x > 0.97) q.x = 0.97; if (q.x < -0.97) q.x = -0.97;
      if (q.y > 0.97) q.y = 0.05; if (q.y < 0.02) q.y = 0.05;      // wrap the loop
      if (Math.abs(q.x) > 0.9 && q.y < 0.06) q.y = 0.1;
      const T = tempAt(q.x, q.y);
      ctx.fillStyle = heatColor(T);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(px + (q.x + 1) / 2 * pw, py + q.y * ph, 3.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.restore();

    // circulation arrows
    const ax = px + pw / 2;
    arrow(ctx, ax, py + ph * 0.75, ax, py + ph * 0.35, { color: '#ef9f68', width: 2.6, head: 9 });
    arrow(ctx, ax + pw * 0.1, py + ph * 0.14, ax + pw * 0.34, py + ph * 0.14, { color: '#ef9f68', width: 2.2, head: 8 });
    arrow(ctx, px + pw * 0.9, py + ph * 0.3, px + pw * 0.9, py + ph * 0.7, { color: '#a8d3e0', width: 2.2, head: 8 });
    arrow(ctx, px + pw * 0.3, py + ph * 0.86, px + pw * 0.12, py + ph * 0.86, { color: '#a8d3e0', width: 2.2, head: 8 });
    label(ctx, 'hot fluid rises (less dense)', ax + 10, py + ph * 0.5, { color: '#ef9f68', size: 11, align: 'left', weight: '700' });
    label(ctx, 'cool fluid sinks', px + pw * 0.86, py + ph * 0.5, { color: '#a8d3e0', size: 11, align: 'right', weight: '700' });
  }

  function radiationScene(ctx, w, h, st) {
    const sx = w * 0.14, sy = h * 0.5, dPx = (w * 0.62) * (state.dist / 3);
    const plateX = sx + Math.max(dPx, w * 0.22);
    const I = intensity();

    // source: flat disc with tick rays
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f6d36b';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx, sy, 24, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#f6d36b'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
      const a = (i / 12) * Math.PI * 2 + st.t * 0.4;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(sx + Math.cos(a) * 28, sy + Math.sin(a) * 28);
      ctx.lineTo(sx + Math.cos(a) * 35, sy + Math.sin(a) * 35);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
    label(ctx, `radiator ${state.power} W`, sx, sy + 52, { color: '#f6d36b', size: 11.5, weight: '700' });

    // plates: matt black (alpha .9) and shiny (alpha .1)
    const plates = [
      { y: sy - h * 0.22, fill: '#3a3d45', a: 0.9, name: 'matt black · α = 0.9' },
      { y: sy + h * 0.22, fill: '#e2e8f0', a: 0.1, name: 'shiny · α = 0.1' }
    ];
    for (const pl of plates) {
      // rays to the plate
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(246,211,107,.8)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
      for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(sx + 26, sy + i * 5);
        ctx.lineTo(plateX - 8, pl.y + i * 7);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      if (pl.a < 0.5) {                              // the shiny one reflects
        ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]); ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(168,211,224,.8)';
        for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i += 2) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(plateX - 8, pl.y + i * 8);
          ctx.lineTo(plateX - 70, pl.y + i * 26);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      }
      ctx.restore();
      ctx.save();
      ctx.fillStyle = pl.fill; ctx.strokeStyle = '#5b7299'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.fillRect(plateX - 8, pl.y - 26, 14, 52);
      ctx.strokeRect(plateX - 8, pl.y - 26, 14, 52);
      ctx.restore();
      label(ctx, pl.name, plateX + 16, pl.y - 12, { color: '#e8eefb', size: 11, align: 'left', weight: '700' });
      label(ctx, `absorbs ${eng(pl.a * I, 3)} W/m²`, plateX + 16, pl.y + 10, { color: heatColor(pl.a * I * 2), size: 11, align: 'left', weight: '700' });
    }

    // distance marker
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(148,163,184,.6)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.4; ctx.setLineDash([3, 5]);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx, h - 26); ctx.lineTo(plateX, h - 26); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
    label(ctx, `d = ${fixed(state.dist, 2)} m`, (sx + plateX) / 2, h - 14, { color: '#a9bad6', size: 11 });
    label(ctx, `I = P/(4πd²) = ${eng(I, 3)} W/m² here`, w / 2, 16, { color: '#f6d36b', size: 12, weight: '700' });
  }

  /* ---- stage ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  const stage = new Stage(canvas, (ctx, w, h, st, dt) => {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    const d = dt || 0.016;
    if (state.mode === 'conduction') conductionScene(ctx, w, h, st, d);
    else if (state.mode === 'convection') convectionScene(ctx, w, h, st, d);
    else radiationScene(ctx, w, h, st);
    readoutsLive();               // capped at 15 Hz; controls below call updateReadouts() directly
  }, { animate: true });

  /* ---- readouts ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  const el = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const readoutsLive = throttle(() => updateReadouts(), 15);
  function updateReadouts() {
    const set = (l, v, lt, vt) => { setText(el(l), lt); if (v) setText(el(v), vt); };
    if (state.mode === 'conduction') {
      const k = MATERIALS[state.material].k;
      set('ht-r1l', 'ht-r1', 'hot end', `${fixed(state.T[0], 0)} \u00B0C`);
      set('ht-r2l', 'ht-r2', 'cold end', `${fixed(state.T[ROD.N - 1], 0)} \u00B0C`);
      set('ht-r3l', 'ht-r3', 'heat flux q', unit(flux(), 'W', 3));
      set('ht-r4l', 'ht-r4', `k \u00B7 ${MATERIALS[state.material].name}`, `${k} W/(m\u00B7K)`);
      setText(el('ht-sub'),
        `q = k\u00B7A\u00B7\u0394T/L = ${k} \u00D7 1\u00D710\u207B\u2074 m\u00B2 \u00D7 ${fixed(state.T[0] - state.T[ROD.N - 1], 0)} K / ${ROD.L} m = ${eng(flux(), 3)} W`);
      setText(el('ht-note'),
        'Conduction: energy hops atom-to-atom through direct contact \u2014 the material never moves. Metals lead by orders of magnitude because their free electrons carry energy too. Watch the profile relax to its straight steady state.');
    } else if (state.mode === 'convection') {
      set('ht-r1l', 'ht-r1', 'heater power', `${state.power} W`);
      set('ht-r2l', 'ht-r2', 'circulation', state.power > 1400 ? 'vigorous' : state.power > 700 ? 'moderate' : 'gentle');
      set('ht-r3l', 'ht-r3', 'hot region', 'bottom centre');
      set('ht-r4l', 'ht-r4', 'cool region', 'top & sides');
      setText(el('ht-sub'),
        'more power \u2192 faster plume \u2192 more energy carried per second (the loop itself is the conveyor belt)');
      setText(el('ht-note'),
        'Convection: the fluid itself moves and carries the energy with it. Heated fluid expands, becomes less dense and rises; cooler fluid sinks to replace it \u2014 a circulation loop. This is why radiators sit under windows and freezers chill from the top.');
    } else {
      const I = intensity();
      set('ht-r1l', 'ht-r1', 'intensity at d', unit(I, 'W/m\u00B2', 3));
      set('ht-r2l', 'ht-r2', 'absorbed \u00B7 matt black', unit(0.9 * I, 'W/m\u00B2', 3));
      set('ht-r3l', 'ht-r3', 'absorbed \u00B7 shiny', unit(0.1 * I, 'W/m\u00B2', 3));
      set('ht-r4l', 'ht-r4', 'distance d', `${fixed(state.dist, 2)} m`);
      setText(el('ht-sub'),
        `I = P/(4\u03C0d\u00B2) = ${state.power} / (4\u03C0 \u00D7 ${fixed(state.dist, 2)}\u00B2) = ${eng(I, 3)} W/m\u00B2 \u2014 halve d and I quadruples (inverse square)`);
      setText(el('ht-note'),
        'Radiation: energy carried by electromagnetic waves \u2014 the only mechanism that crosses a vacuum, which is how sunlight reaches Earth. Matt black surfaces absorb (and emit) best; shiny surfaces reflect most of what hits them.');
    }
  }

  /* ---- controls -------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  function syncVisibility() {
    const show = (id, on) => { const n = el(id); if (n) n.style.display = on ? '' : 'none'; };
    show('ht-ctl-hot', state.mode === 'conduction');
    show('ht-ctl-material', state.mode === 'conduction');
    show('ht-ctl-power', state.mode !== 'conduction');
    show('ht-ctl-dist', state.mode === 'radiation');
  }
  bindSegment('ht-mode', v => { state.mode = v; syncVisibility(); stage.setIdle(false); stage.invalidate(); updateReadouts(); });
  bindSegment('ht-material', v => { state.material = v; converged = false; stage.setIdle(false); updateReadouts(); });
  bindRange('ht-hot', 'ht-hotv', v => { state.Thot = v; converged = false; stage.setIdle(false); updateReadouts(); }, v => `${v} °C`);
  bindRange('ht-power', 'ht-powerv', v => { state.power = v; stage.setIdle(false); stage.invalidate(); updateReadouts(); }, v => `${v} W`);
  bindRange('ht-dist', 'ht-distv', v => { state.dist = v; stage.invalidate(); updateReadouts(); }, v => `${fixed(v, 2)} m`);
  syncVisibility();
  updateReadouts();
  }
})();
````

### `archive/js/sim-sound.js` (9.3 KiB)

````javascript
/* Sim — tone player: frequency vs pitch. A guarded WebAudio oscillator you can actually listen to, with a live oscilloscope (or a drawn waveform when audio is unavailable), a note ruler and the wavelength of the note in air, lambda = v_sound / f. Flat art only. */
(function () {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('sim-sound');
  if (!canvas) return;

  EMC.whenNear(canvas, init);
  function init() {

  const { CONST, clamp, fixed, label, arrow, Stage, bindRange, bindSegment } = EMC;

  const FMIN = 55, FMAX = 1760;
  const state = { f: 440, wave: 'sine', playing: false };

  /* ---- audio (lazily created on the first user gesture, fully guarded) ---- */
  const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext || null;
  let actx = null, osc = null, gain = null, analyser = null, buf = null;

  function audioStart() {
    if (!AC) return false;
    try {
      if (!actx) {
        actx = new AC();
        analyser = actx.createAnalyser();
        analyser.fftSize = 2048;
        buf = new Uint8Array(analyser.fftSize);
        analyser.connect(actx.destination);
      }
      if (actx.state === 'suspended' && actx.resume) actx.resume();
      osc = actx.createOscillator();
      gain = actx.createGain();
      osc.type = state.wave;
      osc.frequency.value = state.f;
      gain.gain.value = 0.0001;
      osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(analyser);
      osc.start();
      gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.08, actx.currentTime + 0.04);
      return true;
    } catch (e) { return false; }
  }
  function audioStop() {
    try {
      if (gain && actx) gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, actx.currentTime + 0.05);
      if (osc) {
        osc.stop(actx.currentTime + 0.08);
        osc.onended = () => { try { osc && osc.disconnect(); } catch (e) {} try { gain && gain.disconnect(); } catch (e) {} };
      }
      // let the shared context sleep until the next gesture instead of
      // keeping the audio thread awake for silence
      if (actx && actx.state === 'running' && actx.suspend) actx.suspend();
    } catch (e) { /* already gone */ }
    osc = null; gain = null;
  }
  function audioSet() {
    if (osc) { try { osc.type = state.wave; osc.frequency.value = state.f; } catch (e) {} }
  }

  /* ---- note naming ---------------------------------------------------------- */
  const NAMES = ['C', 'C\u266F', 'D', 'D\u266F', 'E', 'F', 'F\u266F', 'G', 'G\u266F', 'A', 'A\u266F', 'B'];
  function noteOf(f) {
    const n = Math.round(69 + 12 * Math.log2(f / 440));          // MIDI number (A4 = 69)
    const name = NAMES[((n % 12) + 12) % 12];
    const octave = Math.floor(n / 12) - 1;
    const fRef = 440 * Math.pow(2, (n - 69) / 12);
    const cents = Math.round(1200 * Math.log2(f / fRef));
    return { text: `${name}${octave}`, cents };
  }

  /* ---- waveform maths (used for the drawn scope) ---------------------------- */
  function waveAt(phi) {                       // phi in cycles, output -1..1
    const t = phi - Math.floor(phi);
    switch (state.wave) {
      case 'square': return t < 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
      case 'sawtooth': return 2 * t - 1;
      case 'triangle': return 1 - 4 * Math.abs(t - 0.5);
      default: return Math.sin(2 * Math.PI * t);
    }
  }

  /* ---- stage ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  const stage = new Stage(canvas, (ctx, w, h, st) => {
    stage.setIdle(!state.playing);      // the scope is static unless a tone is playing
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    const scopeH = h * 0.52, sy = h * 0.30;

    // oscilloscope frame
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,15,28,.9)';
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#5b7299'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(w * 0.05, sy - scopeH / 2, w * 0.9, scopeH); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    // trace: live analyser data when playing, else the pure maths
    const x0 = w * 0.05, sw = w * 0.9;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = state.playing ? '#b5d777' : '#a8d3e0';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.4; ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
    ctx.beginPath();
    let live = false;
    if (state.playing && analyser && buf) { try { analyser.getByteTimeDomainData(buf); live = true; } catch (e) { live = false; } }
    const cycles = 3;
    for (let i = 0; i <= sw; i += 2) {
      let v;
      if (live) {
        const idx = Math.floor((i / sw) * (buf.length - 1));
        v = (buf[idx] - 128) / 128 * 1.6;
      } else {
        v = waveAt((i / sw) * cycles + st.t * state.f * 0.25);
      }
      const y = sy - clamp(v, -1.2, 1.2) * scopeH * 0.42;
      i === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(x0 + i, y) : ctx.lineTo(x0 + i, y);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
    label(ctx, live ? 'live microphone-free scope (AnalyserNode)' : `${state.wave} wave · drawn from y = f(2\u03C0ft)`,
      w / 2, sy + scopeH / 2 + 16, { color: '#7b8db0', size: 10.5, weight: '600' });

    // pitch ruler: log scale from FMIN to FMAX with note ticks
    const ry = h * 0.78, rx0 = w * 0.08, rw = w * 0.84;
    const fx = f => rx0 + rw * (Math.log2(f) - Math.log2(FMIN)) / (Math.log2(FMAX) - Math.log2(FMIN));
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(148,163,184,.5)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(rx0, ry); ctx.lineTo(rx0 + rw, ry); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
    for (let midi = 33; midi <= 93; midi++) {
      const f = 440 * Math.pow(2, (midi - 69) / 12);
      if (f < FMIN || f > FMAX) continue;
      const isC = ((midi % 12) + 12) % 12 === 0;
      const x = fx(f);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = isC ? 'rgba(232,238,251,.8)' : 'rgba(148,163,184,.4)';
      ctx.lineWidth = isC ? 2 : 1;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, ry - (isC ? 7 : 4)); ctx.lineTo(x, ry + (isC ? 7 : 4)); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
      if (isC) label(ctx, `C${Math.floor(midi / 12) - 1}`, x, ry + 18, { color: '#a9bad6', size: 10 });
    }
    // needle at the current frequency
    const nx = fx(clamp(state.f, FMIN, FMAX));
    arrow(ctx, nx, ry - 26, nx, ry - 8, { color: '#f6d36b', width: 2.6, head: 8 });
    const note = noteOf(state.f);
    label(ctx, `${note.text}${note.cents ? ` ${note.cents > 0 ? '+' : ''}${note.cents}\u00A2` : ''}`,
      nx, ry - 36, { color: '#f6d36b', size: 13, weight: '800' });
    label(ctx, 'lower pitch', rx0 + 4, ry + 34, { color: '#7b8db0', size: 10.5, align: 'left' });
    label(ctx, 'higher pitch', rx0 + rw - 4, ry + 34, { color: '#7b8db0', size: 10.5, align: 'right' });
    label(ctx, `${fixed(state.f, 0)} Hz`, w / 2, h - 8, { color: 'rgba(148,163,184,.9)', size: 11, weight: '700' });
  }, { animate: true });

  /* ---- readouts ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  const el = id => document.getElementById(id);
  function setStatus(txt) { if (el('snd-status')) el('snd-status').textContent = txt; }
  function updateReadouts() {
    const note = noteOf(state.f);
    if (el('snd-note')) el('snd-note').textContent = `${note.text}${note.cents ? ` (${note.cents > 0 ? '+' : ''}${note.cents} cents)` : ' (exact)'}`;
    if (el('snd-lambda')) el('snd-lambda').textContent = `${fixed(CONST.V_SOUND / state.f, 2)} m`;
    if (el('snd-period')) el('snd-period').textContent = `${fixed(1000 / state.f, 2)} ms`;
    if (el('snd-sub')) {
      el('snd-sub').textContent =
        `\u03BB = v/f = ${CONST.V_SOUND} \u00F7 ${fixed(state.f, 0)} = ${fixed(CONST.V_SOUND / state.f, 2)} m in air at 20 \u00B0C` +
        `  \u00B7  one cycle every ${fixed(1000 / state.f, 1)} ms`;
    }
  }

  /* ---- controls -------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  const slider = el('snd-f');
  if (slider) slider.addEventListener('input', () => {
    state.f = parseFloat(slider.value);
    if (el('snd-fv')) el('snd-fv').textContent = `${fixed(state.f, 0)} Hz`;
    audioSet(); stage.invalidate(); updateReadouts();
  });
  bindSegment('snd-wave', v => { state.wave = v; audioSet(); stage.invalidate(); });

  const playBtn = el('snd-play');
  if (playBtn) playBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (!state.playing) {
      if (!audioStart()) {
        setStatus('Audio is not available in this browser \u2014 the waveform view still shows exactly what you would hear.');
        EMC.toast('Audio unavailable \u2014 look at the scope instead', 'warn');
        return;
      }
      state.playing = true;
      stage.setIdle(false);
      playBtn.textContent = 'Stop tone';
      playBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
      setStatus(`playing ${fixed(state.f, 0)} Hz ${state.wave} \u2014 that is pitch ${noteOf(state.f).text}`);
    } else {
      audioStop();
      state.playing = false;
      stage.setIdle(true); stage.invalidate();
      playBtn.textContent = 'Play tone';
      playBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
      setStatus('stopped \u2014 press Play to hear the pitch again');
    }
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-snd-preset]').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const f = parseFloat(btn.dataset.sndPreset);
      state.f = clamp(f, FMIN, FMAX);
      if (slider) { slider.value = String(state.f); slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); }
      audioSet(); stage.invalidate(); updateReadouts();
      EMC.toast(`Preset: ${btn.textContent.trim()} — ${fixed(state.f, 1)} Hz`);
    });
  });

  if (el('snd-fv')) el('snd-fv').textContent = `${fixed(state.f, 0)} Hz`;
  setStatus(AC ? 'ready \u2014 press Play to hear the tone' : 'audio unavailable in this browser \u2014 the scope still works');
  updateReadouts();
  }
})();
````

### `archive/js/sim-thermometer.js` (6.7 KiB)

````javascript
/* Sim — interactive thermometer. Drag the column or use the slider: the mercury height maps linearly to temperature and the °C / °F / K conversions are recomputed live from °F = °C×9/5 + 32 and K = °C + 273.15. Flat art only. */
(function () {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('sim-thermometer');
  if (!canvas) return;

  EMC.whenNear(canvas, init);
  function init() {

  const { clamp, fixed, label, Stage } = EMC;

  const TMIN = -80, TMAX = 250;
  const state = { T: 20 };

  const toF = C => C * 9 / 5 + 32;
  const toK = C => C + 273.15;

  /* ---- geometry ------------------------------------------------------------ */
  function geom(w, h) {
    const cx = w * 0.30;
    const bulbR = Math.min(26, h * 0.09);
    const bulbY = h - bulbR - 14;
    const topY = 26;
    const tubeW = 15;
    const yOf = T => bulbY - 6 - ((T - TMIN) / (TMAX - TMIN)) * (bulbY - 6 - topY);
    return { cx, bulbR, bulbY, topY, tubeW, yOf, TOfY: y => TMIN + ((bulbY - 6 - y) / (bulbY - 6 - topY)) * (TMAX - TMIN) };
  }

  let dragging = false;
  const stage = new Stage(canvas, (ctx, w, h) => {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    const G = geom(w, h);
    const yT = G.yOf(clamp(state.T, TMIN, TMAX));

    // tube + bulb outline
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,15,28,.94)';
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#5b7299'; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.rect(G.cx - G.tubeW / 2, G.topY, G.tubeW, G.bulbY - G.topY + 8); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(G.cx, G.bulbY, G.bulbR, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();

    // mercury: bulb always full, column up to yT (flat rose fill)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f8aebe';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(G.cx, G.bulbY, G.bulbR - 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillRect(G.cx - 4.5, yT, 9, G.bulbY - yT + 6);
    ctx.restore();

    // scale ticks every 10 degC, labelled every 50
    ctx.save();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(148,163,184,.55)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let T = TMIN; T <= TMAX; T += 10) {
      const y = G.yOf(T), big = T % 50 === 0;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(G.cx + G.tubeW / 2 + 3, y);
      ctx.lineTo(G.cx + G.tubeW / 2 + (big ? 13 : 7), y);
      ctx.stroke();
      if (big) label(ctx, `${T}°`, G.cx + G.tubeW / 2 + 18, y, { color: '#a9bad6', size: 10.5, align: 'left' });
    }
    ctx.restore();

    // landmark markers
    const marker = (T, text, color) => {
      if (T < TMIN || T > TMAX) return;
      const y = G.yOf(T);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]); ctx.strokeStyle = color; ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(G.cx - 42, y); ctx.lineTo(G.cx + G.tubeW / 2 + 44, y); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
      label(ctx, text, G.cx - 46, y, { color, size: 10.5, align: 'right', weight: '700' });
    };
    marker(0, 'water freezes', '#a8d3e0');
    marker(37, 'body 37 °C', '#f6d36b');
    marker(100, 'water boils', '#f8aebe');
    marker(-40, '°C = °F', '#b5d777');

    // the reading, big, next to the column top
    label(ctx, `${fixed(state.T, 1)} °C`, G.cx, yT - 14, { color: '#e8eefb', size: 15, weight: '800' });

    // conversion panel on the right
    const px = w * 0.58, py = h * 0.24;
    label(ctx, 'CONVERSIONS', px, py - 34, { color: '#7b8db0', size: 11, align: 'left', weight: '700' });
    label(ctx, `°F = ${fixed(state.T, 1)} × 9/5 + 32 = ${fixed(toF(state.T), 1)} °F`,
      px, py, { color: '#f6d36b', size: 12.5, align: 'left', weight: '700' });
    label(ctx, `K  = ${fixed(state.T, 1)} + 273.15 = ${fixed(toK(state.T), 2)} K`,
      px, py + 26, { color: '#a8d3e0', size: 12.5, align: 'left', weight: '700' });
    label(ctx, `absolute zero: −273.15 °C = 0 K`,
      px, py + 62, { color: 'rgba(148,163,184,.85)', size: 11, align: 'left', weight: '600' });
    label(ctx, 'drag the column, or use the slider', w / 2, h - 8,
      { color: 'rgba(148,163,184,.8)', size: 10.5, weight: '600' });
  }, { animate: false });

  /* ---- pointer: drag along the tube ---------------------------------------- */
  stage.onPointer(p => {
    const G = geom(stage.w, stage.h);
    if (p.type === 'down') {
      dragging = Math.abs(p.x - G.cx) < 60;
    } else if (p.type === 'up' || p.type === 'leave') {
      dragging = false;
    }
    if (dragging && (p.type === 'down' || p.type === 'move')) {
      setT(G.TOfY(p.y));
    }
  });

  /* ---- readouts ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
  const el = id => document.getElementById(id);
  function setT(T) {
    state.T = clamp(Math.round(T * 2) / 2, TMIN, TMAX);   // snap to 0.5 deg
    const sl = el('thermo-T');
    if (sl && parseFloat(sl.value) !== state.T) sl.value = String(state.T);
    const num = el('thermo-Tnum');
    if (num && document.activeElement !== num) num.value = String(state.T);
    if (el('thermo-Tv')) el('thermo-Tv').textContent = `${fixed(state.T, 1)} °C`;
    if (el('thermo-C')) el('thermo-C').textContent = `${fixed(state.T, 1)} °C`;
    if (el('thermo-F')) el('thermo-F').textContent = `${fixed(toF(state.T), 1)} °F`;
    if (el('thermo-K')) el('thermo-K').textContent = `${fixed(toK(state.T), 2)} K`;
    if (el('thermo-sub')) {
      el('thermo-sub').textContent =
        `°F = ${fixed(state.T, 1)} × 9/5 + 32 = ${fixed(toF(state.T), 1)}   ·   K = ${fixed(state.T, 1)} + 273.15 = ${fixed(toK(state.T), 2)}`;
    }
    if (el('thermo-note')) {
      const T = state.T;
      el('thermo-note').textContent =
        T <= -78.5 ? 'Colder than sublimating dry ice (−78.5 °C) — welcome to the deep cold.'
        : Math.abs(T + 40) < 2 ? '−40° is the unique point where the Celsius and Fahrenheit scales read the same number.'
        : Math.abs(T) < 2 ? '0 °C: the freezing point of water — one of the two fixed points the scales were built from.'
        : Math.abs(T - 37) < 2 ? '37 °C: normal human body temperature (98.6 °F).'
        : Math.abs(T - 100) < 2 ? '100 °C: water boils at sea-level pressure. Lower on a mountain — boiling point tracks pressure.'
        : T > 200 ? 'Hotter than most kitchen ovens. Lead melts at 327 °C, just off the top of this scale.'
        : 'Drag the column or move the slider — all three scales update together.';
    }
    stage.invalidate();
  }

  /* ---- controls -------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  const slider = el('thermo-T');
  if (slider) slider.addEventListener('input', () => setT(parseFloat(slider.value)));
  const num = el('thermo-Tnum');
  if (num) num.addEventListener('change', () => {
    const v = parseFloat(num.value);
    if (isFinite(v)) setT(v); else num.value = String(state.T);
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-thermo-preset]').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      setT(parseFloat(btn.dataset.thermoPreset));
      EMC.toast(`Preset: ${fixed(state.T, 1)} °C`);
    });
  });

  setT(state.T);
  }
})();
````

### `archive/js/sim-vector-add.js` (7.8 KiB)

````javascript
/* Sim — Vector addition bench. Drag the arrowheads of A and B; the resultant R = A + B is recomposed live by components, shown as the parallelogram diagonal (or the closing side in tip-to-tail mode). Flat art only: solid fills, dashed guides, no fancy effects. */
(function () {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('sim-vector-add');
  if (!canvas) return;

  EMC.whenNear(canvas, init);
  function init() {

  const { clamp, fixed, arrow, label, Stage, bindSegment } = EMC;

  /* ---- state ----------------------------------------------------------- */
  const DEFAULTS = { A: { x: 3, y: 1 }, B: { x: 1, y: 3 } };
  const state = {
    A: { ...DEFAULTS.A },
    B: { ...DEFAULTS.B },
    mode: 'parallelogram',       // 'parallelogram' | 'tip' (tip-to-tail)
    drag: null                   // 'A' | 'B' | null
  };
  const R = () => ({ x: state.A.x + state.B.x, y: state.A.y + state.B.y });

  /* ---- coordinate mapping ---------------------------------------------- */
  const UNITS = 10;                                   // grid spans ±5 units
  function scale(w, h) { return Math.min(w, h) / UNITS; }
  function origin(w, h) { return { x: w / 2, y: h / 2 }; }
  const toPx = (v, o, s) => ({ x: o.x + v.x * s, y: o.y - v.y * s });   // y-up
  const toUnits = (px, o, s) => ({ x: (px.x - o.x) / s, y: (o.y - px.y) / s });

  /* ---- pointer: drag the arrowheads ------------------------------------- */
  const stage = new Stage(canvas, render, { animate: false });
  stage.onPointer(p => {
    const o = origin(stage.w, stage.h), s = scale(stage.w, stage.h);
    const tipA = toPx(state.A, o, s);
    const bTail = state.mode === 'tip' ? tipA : o;
    const tipB = { x: bTail.x + state.B.x * s, y: bTail.y - state.B.y * s };
    if (p.type === 'down') {
      const dA = Math.hypot(p.x - tipA.x, p.y - tipA.y);
      const dB = Math.hypot(p.x - tipB.x, p.y - tipB.y);
      state.drag = (dA < 30 && dA <= dB) ? 'A' : (dB < 30 ? 'B' : null);   // 30 px hit halo, generous for touch
      canvas.style.cursor = state.drag ? 'grabbing' : 'default';
    } else if (p.type === 'up' || p.type === 'leave') {
      state.drag = null; canvas.style.cursor = 'default';
    }
    if (state.drag && (p.type === 'down' || p.type === 'move')) {
      const u = toUnits({ x: p.x, y: p.y }, o, s);
      const v = { x: clamp(Math.round(u.x * 10) / 10, -5, 5), y: clamp(Math.round(u.y * 10) / 10, -5, 5) };
      if (state.drag === 'A') state.A = v;
      else state.B = v;                       // B is stored as a free vector in both modes
      refresh();
    }
  });

  /* ---- rendering --------------------------------------------------------- */
  function render(ctx, w, h) {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    const o = origin(w, h), s = scale(w, h);
    const r = R();

    // grid (1-unit squares) + axes
    ctx.save();
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (let i = -5; i <= 5; i++) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = i === 0 ? 'rgba(148,163,184,.5)' : 'rgba(148,163,184,.13)';
      const gx = o.x + i * s, gy = o.y - i * s;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(gx, o.y - 5 * s); ctx.lineTo(gx, o.y + 5 * s); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(o.x - 5 * s, gy); ctx.lineTo(o.x + 5 * s, gy); ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.restore();
    label(ctx, 'x', o.x + 5 * s - 6, o.y + 14, { color: '#7b8db0', size: 11 });
    label(ctx, 'y', o.x + 12, o.y - 5 * s + 8, { color: '#7b8db0', size: 11 });

    const tipA = toPx(state.A, o, s);
    const tipB0 = toPx(state.B, o, s);
    const tipR = toPx(r, o, s);
    const bTail = state.mode === 'tip' ? tipA : o;
    const tipB = { x: bTail.x + state.B.x * s, y: bTail.y - state.B.y * s };

    // parallelogram guides (dashed)
    ctx.save();
    ctx.setLineDash([5, 5]); ctx.lineWidth = 1.6; ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(213,184,216,.65)';
    if (state.mode === 'parallelogram') {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tipA.x, tipA.y); ctx.lineTo(tipR.x, tipR.y); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tipB0.x, tipB0.y); ctx.lineTo(tipR.x, tipR.y); ctx.stroke();
    } else {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(o.x, o.y); ctx.lineTo(tipB0.x, tipB0.y); ctx.stroke();  // ghost of B at the origin
    }
    // component projections of R
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(148,163,184,.55)';
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tipR.x, tipR.y); ctx.lineTo(tipR.x, o.y); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tipR.x, tipR.y); ctx.lineTo(o.x, tipR.y); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
    label(ctx, `Rx ${fixed(r.x, 1)}`, (o.x + tipR.x) / 2, o.y + (r.y >= 0 ? 14 : -12), { color: '#a9bad6', size: 11 });
    label(ctx, `Ry ${fixed(r.y, 1)}`, tipR.x + (r.x >= 0 ? 26 : -26), (o.y + tipR.y) / 2, { color: '#a9bad6', size: 11 });

    // the three arrows: A cyan, B amber, resultant emerald
    arrow(ctx, o.x, o.y, tipA.x, tipA.y, { color: '#a8d3e0', width: 3, head: 11 });
    arrow(ctx, bTail.x, bTail.y, tipB.x, tipB.y, { color: '#f6d36b', width: 3, head: 11 });
    arrow(ctx, o.x, o.y, tipR.x, tipR.y, { color: '#b5d777', width: 3.6, head: 12 });

    // arrow labels
    const mid = (p, q, off) => ({ x: (p.x + q.x) / 2 + off.x, y: (p.y + q.y) / 2 + off.y });
    const la = mid(o, tipA, { x: -14, y: -10 });
    const lb = mid(bTail, tipB, { x: 14, y: -10 });
    label(ctx, 'A', la.x, la.y, { color: '#a8d3e0', size: 13, weight: '800' });
    label(ctx, 'B', lb.x, lb.y, { color: '#f6d36b', size: 13, weight: '800' });
    label(ctx, 'R = A + B', clamp(tipR.x + 12, 8, w - 78), clamp(tipR.y - 12, 14, h - 8),
      { color: '#b5d777', size: 12, weight: '800', align: 'left' });

    // drag handles
    [tipA, tipB].forEach((t, i) => {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.fillStyle = i === 0 ? '#a8d3e0' : '#f6d36b';
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#0b1220'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, 6.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    });

    label(ctx, 'drag the arrowheads · grid = 1 unit', w / 2, h - 10,
      { color: 'rgba(148,163,184,.8)', size: 10.5, weight: '600' });
  }

  /* ---- readouts ----------------------------------------------------------- */
  const el = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const mag = v => Math.hypot(v.x, v.y);
  const ang = v => Math.atan2(v.y, v.x) * 180 / Math.PI;
  function updateReadouts() {
    const r = R();
    if (el('vec-Amag')) el('vec-Amag').textContent = `${fixed(mag(state.A), 2)} u`;
    if (el('vec-Aang')) el('vec-Aang').textContent = `${fixed(ang(state.A), 1)}°`;
    if (el('vec-Bmag')) el('vec-Bmag').textContent = `${fixed(mag(state.B), 2)} u`;
    if (el('vec-Bang')) el('vec-Bang').textContent = `${fixed(ang(state.B), 1)}°`;
    if (el('vec-Rx')) el('vec-Rx').textContent = fixed(r.x, 1);
    if (el('vec-Ry')) el('vec-Ry').textContent = fixed(r.y, 1);
    if (el('vec-Rmag')) el('vec-Rmag').textContent = `${fixed(mag(r), 2)} u`;
    if (el('vec-Rang')) el('vec-Rang').textContent = `${fixed(ang(r), 1)}°`;
    if (el('vec-sub')) {
      el('vec-sub').textContent =
        `Rx = Ax + Bx = ${fixed(state.A.x, 1)} + ${fixed(state.B.x, 1)} = ${fixed(r.x, 1)}` +
        `  ·  Ry = Ay + By = ${fixed(state.A.y, 1)} + ${fixed(state.B.y, 1)} = ${fixed(r.y, 1)}` +
        `  ·  |R| = √(Rx² + Ry²) = ${fixed(mag(r), 2)} u`;
    }
  }
  function refresh() { stage.invalidate(); updateReadouts(); }

  /* ---- controls ------------------------------------------------------------ */
  bindSegment('vec-mode', v => { state.mode = v; refresh(); });

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-vec-preset]').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const [ax, ay, bx, by] = btn.dataset.vecPreset.split(',').map(Number);
      state.A = { x: ax, y: ay }; state.B = { x: bx, y: by };
      refresh();
      EMC.toast(`Preset: A = (${ax}, ${ay}), B = (${bx}, ${by})`);
    });
  });
  const reset = el('vec-reset');
  if (reset) reset.addEventListener('click', () => {
    state.A = { ...DEFAULTS.A }; state.B = { ...DEFAULTS.B }; refresh();
  });

  refresh();
  }
})();
````

### `archive/js/sim-wave.js` (7.2 KiB)

````javascript
/* Sim — travelling wave bench. y(x,t) = A sin(kx - omega t) with k = 2*pi/lambda and omega = 2*pi*f, drawn as a transverse wave or a longitudinal (compression) wave. The wave speed is always computed, never assumed: v = f * lambda. Flat art only. */
(function () {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('sim-wave');
  if (!canvas) return;

  EMC.whenNear(canvas, init);
  function init() {

  const { clamp, fixed, arrow, label, Stage, bindRange, bindSegment } = EMC;

  const state = {
    A: 8,            // cm
    f: 1,            // Hz
    lambda: 2,       // m
    type: 'transverse',
    particles: true,
    paused: false,
    phase: 0         // accumulated cycles
  };

  const PX_PER_M = () => 90;
  const phys = () => ({ v: state.f * state.lambda, T: state.f > 0 ? 1 / state.f : Infinity, k: 2 * Math.PI / state.lambda, omega: 2 * Math.PI * state.f });

  const stage = new Stage(canvas, (ctx, w, h, st, dt) => {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
    if (!state.paused) state.phase += (dt || 0.016) * state.f;
    const p = phys();
    const mid = h * 0.52;
    const Apx = clamp(state.A * 2.6, 6, h * 0.34);
    const yAt = xM => mid - Apx * Math.sin(p.k * xM - 2 * Math.PI * state.phase);

    if (state.type === 'transverse') {
      // equilibrium axis
      ctx.save();
      ctx.setLineDash([4, 6]); ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(148,163,184,.35)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, mid); ctx.lineTo(w, mid); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();

      // the travelling curve
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#a8d3e0'; ctx.lineWidth = 2.8; ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let px = 0; px <= w; px += 3) {
        const y = yAt(px / PX_PER_M());
        px === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(px, y) : ctx.lineTo(px, y);
      }
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();

      // medium particles: they bob vertically only — the wave travels, the medium does not
      if (state.particles) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#f6d36b';
        const n = Math.floor(w / 26);
        for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
          const px = i * 26;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, yAt(px / PX_PER_M()), 3.2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        }
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // amplitude + wavelength markers
      const xCrest = ((Math.PI / 2 + 2 * Math.PI * state.phase) / p.k) * PX_PER_M();
      const x0 = ((xCrest % (state.lambda * PX_PER_M())) + state.lambda * PX_PER_M()) % (state.lambda * PX_PER_M());
      const x1 = x0 + state.lambda * PX_PER_M();
      if (x1 < w - 30) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#b5d777'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.8; ctx.setLineDash([3, 4]);
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0, mid + Apx + 22); ctx.lineTo(x1, mid + Apx + 22); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();
        arrow(ctx, x0 + 8, mid + Apx + 22, x0, mid + Apx + 22, { color: '#b5d777', width: 1.8, head: 6 });
        arrow(ctx, x1 - 8, mid + Apx + 22, x1, mid + Apx + 22, { color: '#b5d777', width: 1.8, head: 6 });
        label(ctx, `λ = ${fixed(state.lambda, 2)} m`, (x0 + x1) / 2, mid + Apx + 36, { color: '#b5d777', size: 11.5, weight: '700' });
      }
      const crestY = mid - Apx;
      ctx.save();
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#f8aebe'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.6; ctx.setLineDash([3, 4]);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0 + 14, mid); ctx.lineTo(x0 + 14, crestY); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
      label(ctx, `A = ${fixed(state.A, 0)} cm`, x0 + 22, (mid + crestY) / 2, { color: '#f8aebe', size: 11.5, align: 'left', weight: '700' });

      arrow(ctx, w - 90, mid - Apx - 20, w - 24, mid - Apx - 20, { color: '#e8eefb', width: 2.4, head: 9 });
      label(ctx, `v = ${fixed(p.v, 2)} m/s`, w - 57, mid - Apx - 36, { color: '#e8eefb', size: 12, weight: '800' });
    } else {
      // LONGITUDINAL: rows of dots displaced along x — compressions and rarefactions
      const rows = 4, gap = 15;
      const disp = xM => Apx * 0.55 * Math.sin(p.k * xM - 2 * Math.PI * state.phase);
      ctx.save();
      for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        const y = mid - (rows - 1) * gap / 2 + r * gap;
        for (let px = 6; px < w - 6; px += gap) {
          const xM = px / PX_PER_M();
          const dx = disp(xM);
          // density cue: dots crowd where the displacement gradient is negative
          const grad = Math.cos(p.k * xM - 2 * Math.PI * state.phase);
          ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(0.55 + 0.4 * (-grad), 0.25, 1);
          ctx.fillStyle = grad < -0.3 ? '#f6d36b' : '#a8d3e0';
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px + dx, y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        }
      }
      ctx.restore();
      // label one compression and one rarefaction
      const xComp = ((-Math.PI / 2 + 2 * Math.PI * state.phase) / p.k) * PX_PER_M();
      const xc = ((xComp % (state.lambda * PX_PER_M())) + state.lambda * PX_PER_M()) % (state.lambda * PX_PER_M());
      label(ctx, 'compression', clamp(xc + state.lambda * PX_PER_M() / 2, 60, w - 60), mid + (rows - 1) * gap / 2 + 24, { color: '#f6d36b', size: 11.5, weight: '700' });
      label(ctx, 'rarefaction', clamp(xc + state.lambda * PX_PER_M(), 60, w - 60), mid + (rows - 1) * gap / 2 + 24, { color: '#a8d3e0', size: 11.5, weight: '700' });
      arrow(ctx, w - 90, mid - (rows - 1) * gap / 2 - 24, w - 24, mid - (rows - 1) * gap / 2 - 24, { color: '#e8eefb', width: 2.4, head: 9 });
      label(ctx, `v = ${fixed(p.v, 2)} m/s`, w - 57, mid - (rows - 1) * gap / 2 - 40, { color: '#e8eefb', size: 12, weight: '800' });
    }

    label(ctx, state.type === 'transverse'
      ? 'medium moves ↑↓ · wave travels →'
      : 'medium moves ↔ · wave travels →',
      w / 2, h - 10, { color: 'rgba(148,163,184,.85)', size: 10.5, weight: '600' });
  }, { animate: true });

  /* ---- readouts --------------------------------------------------------------- */
  const el = id => document.getElementById(id);
  function updateReadouts() {
    const p = phys();
    if (el('wave-v')) el('wave-v').textContent = `${fixed(p.v, 2)} m/s`;
    if (el('wave-T')) el('wave-T').textContent = `${fixed(p.T, 2)} s`;
    if (el('wave-omega')) el('wave-omega').textContent = `${fixed(p.omega, 2)} rad/s`;
    if (el('wave-sub')) {
      el('wave-sub').textContent =
        `v = f × λ = ${fixed(state.f, 2)} Hz × ${fixed(state.lambda, 2)} m = ${fixed(p.v, 2)} m/s` +
        `  ·  T = 1/f = ${fixed(p.T, 2)} s`;
    }
  }
  function refresh() { updateReadouts(); }

  /* ---- controls ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  bindRange('wave-A', 'wave-Av', v => { state.A = v; stage.invalidate(); refresh(); }, v => `${fixed(v, 0)} cm`);
  bindRange('wave-f', 'wave-fv', v => { state.f = v; stage.invalidate(); refresh(); }, v => `${fixed(v, 2)} Hz`);
  bindRange('wave-lam', 'wave-lamv', v => { state.lambda = v; stage.invalidate(); refresh(); }, v => `${fixed(v, 2)} m`);
  bindSegment('wave-type', v => { state.type = v; stage.invalidate(); });

  const partBox = el('wave-particles');
  if (partBox) partBox.addEventListener('change', () => { state.particles = partBox.checked; });
  const pauseBtn = el('wave-pause');
  if (pauseBtn) pauseBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    state.paused = !state.paused;
    pauseBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(state.paused));
    pauseBtn.textContent = state.paused ? 'Resume' : 'Pause';
  });

  refresh();
  }
})();
````
